what_this_is: A DEBT SNAPSHOT for REQ-HARNESS-5935, not a target and not an approval. As of the baseline commit, 444 of 573 ARC candidate artifacts under results/ carry at least one arc_artifact_lint error (194 INVALID_INFERENCE_SUBSTRATE, 141 MISSING_INFERENCE_SUBSTRATE, 111 NON_TERMINAL_HONEST_VERDICT, 56 LIVE_LLM_NOT_ALLOWLISTED, 53 DURATION_MISSING, 18 DURATION_BELOW_SUBSTRATE_FLOOR; an artifact can carry several). The lint is a pre-commit hook and result artifacts are written once and never re-staged, so it had never inspected the population it governs. Every artifact ADDED after baseline_commit must pass the lint; the standing 444 await per-class repair decisions recorded in ops/known-issues.md (2026-08-28 entry).
how_to_shrink: Fix a failing artifact's WRITER and regenerate, or make the per-class repair the known-issues entry describes. This file needs no update when old debt shrinks; it freezes only the boundary commit. Moving baseline_commit FORWARD past newly-added failing artifacts is the forbidden move -- it converts a regression into debt.
